scraping_method: Two-step async process: maps all category IDs, then fetches products for each category in parallel.

regionalization.description: Injects a regionalization cookie to force Jundiaí prices and stock.

pagination.method: Full pagination within each category ID.
pagination.details: For each category, it fetches all products by incrementing the '_from' parameter until an empty response is received.

selectors_mapping.root_path: Root JSON Array from the search endpoint

special_rules: Relies on a pre-existing session file (atacadao_session.json) for authentication cookies.
First, it hits the '/api/catalog_system/pub/category/tree/3' endpoint to get a full map of department IDs.
Then, it fetches all products for each relevant category ID using the 'fq=C:{id}' parameter.
Implements a robust price extraction logic, checking 'PriceSpecifications' for quantity-based discounts and falling back to 'Teasers' for promotional texts.
Injects a 'regionalization' cookie on every run to ensure prices and stock are from the Jundiaí store.

technical_dependencies.session_management: Loads session from 'atacadao_session.json' and injects regionalization cookie.
